name: MORABO chaise by the stairs, the sofa, and an armchair with its footstool by the play area, all facing the window
notes:
Alternative: Andrew's "chaise addon to sofa + ... chair with foot rest" (2026-10-25). No TV (F-65); the open side's walkway (y 143-173) stays clear (F-42).
The sofa (F-67, Andrew 2026-10-25: "a chaise, i.e. at least 3 seats", "empty space between like" the MORABO chaise add-on, "the largest sofa / sectional / chaise that can fit"): MORABO in Gunnared dark gray on 6 1/4" wood legs, the open base he linked, high enough for a robot vacuum. Its cover is fixed (vacuum and wipe, not washable); the same pieces in Grann/Bomstad leather wipe clean and hold no dust mites (F-66). Every sofa piece is delivery-path-unmeasured (F-22).
One row facing the window, a lounger at each end: the chaise by the stairs and the armchair with its footstool by the play area, the sofa between them. Three seats, the chaise and the armchair.
chaise-1 MORABO chaise add-on, rot 180, x 36-66.75, y 80.75-143: at the sofa's left end, on the edge of the railing's strip (F-40), its back on the walkway edge (F-42), its foot 74.75" from the heater face (F-33); delivery-path-unmeasured (F-22).
sofa-1 MORABO sofa, rot 180, x 66.75-147.875, y 106.75-143: facing the window, the walkway behind it (F-39, F-42); delivery-path-unmeasured (F-22).
armchair-1 MORABO armchair, rot 180, x 148-183.875, y 106.75-143, 1/8" from the sofa's arm; ottoman-1 MORABO ottoman in front of it, x 153.125-178.75, y 70.375-100.75, 6" from its seat: the "chair with foot rest", the parent's spot next to the play floor.
coffee-table-1 VALNÄS, x 84.06-130.56, y 62.375-90.75: 16" from the sofa (F-39), 17.3" from the chaise's side, 22.6" from the ottoman.
floor-lamp-2 TÅGARP, x 72-81, y 12-21: against the window wall left of the window (F-33); the top landing's exit stays 36" wide beside it (x 36-72, F-40). plant-1 FEJKA, x 184.5-193.5, y 133-142: in the corner behind the armchair, at the walkway's edge, off every seat's view.
rug-1 TIOKRONA, x 48.25-166.25, y 29.5-123.5: under the VALNÄS, the ottoman and the front legs of the chaise, the sofa and the armchair; STOPP FILT underlays.
Play area (F-61), as c staged it: kid-chair-1 kid's POÄNG in the window corner with the FLISAT book display beside it and the UPPLYST above; bookcase-1 KALLAX 2x4 (57 5/8" tall) and bookcase-2 KALLAX 2x2 (30 1/8"), both anchored (F-21), drawers and boxes in the extras; art-1 PJÄTTERYD, art-2 RÖDALM, wall-lamp-2 VARPTROSS; rug-2 VALLABY (x 196-235, y 86-138) with kids-table-1 LÄTT on it, 19.1" clear of the armchair.
Walkways: the open side's walkway (F-42); the route along the window, 56" or more between the heater face and the VALNÄS or the ottoman (F-30); the play floor x 184-245.6.
Not placed: the KIVIK sofa with chaise (rejected, F-67); the POÄNG; the LACK console, the side table and the STORSEGEL lamps (no wall for their cords); a second TÅGARP (right of the window it stood 6" from Maddie's chair); the TV (F-65).
Stairs: beyond the left wall behind a railing (F-40), so the 36" strip along it (x 0-36) stays clear its whole length, landings included; the bottom landing opens onto the open side's walkway, the top one onto the floor along the window (F-30). Which end people step off is unknown.
Heater: clearances run from the drawn 6" heater face (heater-depth-assumed): floor pieces from y 12, upholstery from y 18 (F-33). It runs the whole window wall, so the GINSTMOTT panels must stay off it: hem them to end above it once its height is known, or hang blinds as the office does. Window: eyeballed on the top wall (assumed-position:window); nothing stands under it (F-38).
Power: outlets can only be on the window wall and the play wall, and where they are isn't recorded; the TÅGARP stands against the window wall so its 3' 3" cord reaches it without crossing a walkway, and the UPPLYST and VARPTROSS cords on the play wall run down it in covers.
Kid safety (F-21): no glass; both KALLAX units are over 27" (57 5/8" and 30 1/8"), so both are anchored to the wall (anchor-required).
Extras: as c staged them (curtains, rod, cushion covers and inserts, throw, KALLAX drawer inserts and DRÖNA boxes, GNABBAS baskets in the KALLAX, STOPP FILT underlays).
Total $3,202.71, prices as of 2026-10-22 and 2026-10-23 and 2026-10-24 and 2026-10-25 (those before today are price-stale, F-02). Flags across the layout: delivery-path-unmeasured, anchor-required, assumed-position:window, heater-depth-assumed.
